an4.102:1.8: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.102:2.1: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā hoti, no vassitā?
an4.102:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti –
an4.102:2.3: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
an4.102:2.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.102:2.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā hoti, no vassitā.
an4.102:2.6: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako gajjitā, no vassitā;
an4.102:3.1: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo vassitā hoti, no gajjitā?
an4.102:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti –
an4.102:3.3: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
an4.102:3.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti…pe… ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.102:3.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo vassitā hoti, no gajjitā.
an4.102:3.6: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako vassitā, no gajjitā;
an4.102:4.1: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gajjitā hoti, no vassitā?
an4.102:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo neva dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti –
an4.102:4.3: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
an4.102:4.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti…pe… ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.102:4.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gajjitā hoti, no vassitā.
an4.102:4.6: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako neva gajjitā, no vassitā;
an4.102:5.1: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca?
an4.102:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti –
an4.102:5.3: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
an4.102:5.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti…pe… ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.102:5.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca.
an4.102:5.6: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako gajjitā ca vassitā ca;
an4.102:5.8: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmi’’nti.
